etymologies.etymologyHTML: From dis- +‎ trust, alteration of the earlier term wantrust.

definitions.definition: To put no trust in; to have no confidence in.

quote.citation: 2011 May 8, Bryan Cogman, “Cripples, Bastards, and Broken Things”, in Game of Thrones, season 1, episode 4, spoken by Eddard Stark (Sean Bean):
quote.text: Lord Baelish, perhaps I was wrong to distrust you. Petyr Baelish (Aidan Gillen): Distrusting me was the wisest thing you've done since you climbed off your horse.
